stemEn: A newborn has persistent hypoglycemia despite increasing dextrose delivery. Critical labs show inappropriately high insulin and absent ketones. What is the most likely mechanism?
explanationAr: Insulin المرتفع أثناء hypoglycemia مع suppression للketogenesis يدل على hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia. المولود قد يحتاج high glucose infusion rate وقد يحتاج diazoxide أو تدخلات أخرى حسب السبب.
reasoningEn: Inappropriately detectable insulin with suppressed ketones during hypoglycemia is characteristic of hyperinsulinism.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: Interpret insulin together with beta-hydroxybutyrate, free fatty acids, glucose response to glucagon and glucose infusion requirement.

stemEn: A 2-month-old infant has hypoglycemia with high insulin but undetectable C-peptide. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: Exogenous insulin يحتوي insulin بدون C-peptide، لذلك high insulin + suppressed C-peptide أثناء hypoglycemia يشير إلى external insulin administration. في infant يجب التفكير أيضًا في factitious disorder imposed on another وحماية الطفل.
reasoningEn: Endogenous insulin is secreted with C-peptide; high insulin with absent C-peptide points to exogenous insulin.
incorrectOptionsAr: BWS/congenital hyperinsulinism يرفعان endogenous insulin وبالتالي يكون C-peptide detectable.
clinicalPearl: Also test for insulin secretagogues when the biochemical pattern is unclear.

stemEn: A child with classic Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome undergoes abdominal ultrasound. Which renal finding may be associated?

options.text: Nephromegaly / enlarged kidneys with renal abnormalities
Loss of corticomedullary differentiation as a defining feature

explanationAr: Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome قد يرتبط بـnephromegaly، renal medullary abnormalities, cysts, nephrocalcinosis وغيرها. كما يحتاج tumor surveillance حسب guideline.
reasoningEn: Renal enlargement and several structural renal abnormalities are recognized in Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: الخيارات الأخرى ليست الارتباط الأشيع/الأوضح في المصدر.
clinicalPearl: BWS requires age-dependent tumor surveillance for Wilms tumor and hepatoblastoma according to current protocols.
